name: Example Dental Practice
_comment: A worked template, not a working configuration. Every value below is
specific to one practice: service numbering is the payroll's convention,
agenda ids come from that install's TAGPLAN, and the label rules are the
words that practice's staff type by hand. Copy this, then derive the real
values from the database with the exploration commands noted per section.
Point ZAWIN_PROFILE (or site config 'zawin_profile') at your copy.

company.name: Example Dental Practice
company._comment: abbr must match the Frappe Company record: ERPNext appends it to every Department name.

practice_day._comment: Minutes since midnight; fallback only. Per-agenda bounds are read from TAGPLAN.Start/Ende, which differ by discipline. Check with: zawin values TAGPLAN Start

services._comment: Payroll service code -> role and discipline. 'discipline: null' means the code is ambiguous and must be refined from ZaWin (e.g. an assistant pool spanning several disciplines). 'clinical' marks staff who work chairside.

role_color_rules._comment: BEHANDLER.FarbeTermin (default appointment colour, an OLE_COLOR int: R + G*256 + B*65536) -> a Scheduling Role someone holds in addition to their designation-derived one. Optional 'max_rooms' overrides the role's default of 1. Practice-specific judgement calls like this belong in a private companion profile (see cmdb_frappe), not here.

categories._comment: Names as they appear in TAGPLANTERMINKATEGORIE.Bezeichnung_1. List with: zawin categories

agendas._comment: TAGPLAN ids that are rooms, sites or purposes rather than a person's working day — they carry no working time. Find them with: zawin values TAGPLAN Beschreibung (look for mitArbeitszeit = 0).

site_behort._comment: BEHORT id -> branch name, for the ids that mean a site rather than a chair. List with: zawin values BEHORT Beschreibung

thresholds._comment: Defaults are reasonable starting points; verify each against your own data before trusting the output.

zawin._comment: BEHANDLER.Funktion code meaning prophylaxis, if this install uses one; null disables the check. Funktion is more reliable than matching initials suffixes. Inspect with: zawin values BEHANDLER Funktion. prophylaxis_discipline is the Department the resulting 'Prophylaxis' Scheduling Role belongs to; required only if funktion_prophylaxis is set.

overrides._comment: Optional paths, relative to this file, to human-confirmed corrections the matcher cannot infer — renames, and people whose real job differs from their payroll filing. These name identifiable individuals: keep them out of any public repository.
